property_summary: If RState is BELOW_ONE and BASE_TARGET equals BASE_RESERVE then calling correctRState() does not change RState (remains BELOW_ONE) on the original but the mutant flips it to ONE.

After buyShares is called from an account when totalSupply==0, the contract's recorded _BASE_TARGET_ equals the newly set _BASE_RESERVE_ (i.e., getVaultReserve().baseReserve == getPMMStateForCall()'s B0) — original preserves target==reserve at init, mutant can make B0 larger.
After a buyShares call when totalSupply was zero, the contract's base target (B0) is never greater than the base reserve (B); the mutant can make B0 exceed B.

After calling buyShares(...) (from any caller) when totalSupply == 0, the contract's reported base target (B0 returned by getPMMStateForCall) is never strictly greater than the base reserve (B returned by getPMMStateForCall).

After calling buyShares once (from any caller) with totalSupply == 0, the contract's PMM adjusted B0 (getPMMStateForCall()'s B0) is less than or equal to the reported base reserve (getVaultReserve()'s baseReserve).
